a.lede: Candiru spyware was delivered to devices at Al Jazeera Media Network via targeted online advertisements in a zero-click attack that required only rendering the malicious ads on the victim's device. [...]
a.title: Zero-click attacks used targeted ads to deliver Candiru spyware

b.lede: The digital rights unit found evidence that dozens of devices at media organization Al Jazeera were hacked after being shown malicious online ads.
b.title: Citizen Lab says governments are abusing online ads to hack people with ‘zero-click’ spyware
